text: The paper reports that Llama-2-70b with in-context learning shows comparable generalization to hard test data whether fit to easy or hard data: across all six human hardness measures the Supervision Gap Recovered is between 70% and 100%, and these results are statistically significant (CIs and p-values in Appendix Table 2).
title: Llama-2-70b with ICL recovers 70-100% of the supervision gap from easy data
